description: Text4 narrow edge (b): 720px breakpoint with symmetric intra-line span gaps and tabular number column. Exercises the SPACE_XS 4px total / 2px-per-side span pad (uniform internal gaps), right-aligned tabular number gutter (same width for numbers and blanks), 336/336 side-by-side pair at 720 plus 712 stacked single width below the breakpoint, and even trailing-blank balance (11 raw -> 12 paired) in a 300px budget at 17.6px rhythm.
intent: 720px narrow: even intra-line span gaps, tabular right-aligned numbers, paired trailing blanks
